resources.string: Choose a microG account and allow BitChord to manage your YouTube music library. microG connects to Google using its own network settings.
Checking the account with YouTube Music…
Finish signing in or approving YouTube access in microG. When you return to BitChord, you can check the result here.
microG did not answer the token request within 30 seconds. Older versions can leave a failed request unanswered. Check that microG can reach Google using its own network connection, then try again.
microG answered but could not issue YouTube access for this account. Check whether microG can sign in to Google. If it can, the app developer should check the Android OAuth registration for this APK.
YouTube access still needs approval in microG. Choose the account again to retry.
Enable a microG authenticator on this device, then choose an account again. BitChord recognizes microG Services, ReVanced GmsCore, and Vanced microG.
microG could not authorize this account. Check its network connection and the Android OAuth registration for this APK, then try again.
YouTube Music could not verify this account. Check your connection and try again.
Android could not open the account screen provided by microG. Update your installed microG distribution and try again.
This Vanced microG version did not return a token. It has no approval screen for a new app. If this account has not already granted access, use a microG version with YouTube authorization support.
YouTube Music rejected access for BitChord. Check the YouTube permission and the Android OAuth registration for this app and signing certificate.
